Hanno Tourism Information Center & Omiyage Shop Yumema will close from April 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8).

Product sales end March 13, 2026 (Friday). Tourism information services and the adjacent public restroom will remain open until March 31, 2026 (Tuesday).

Souvenir sales will continue at Hanno Station Tourism Information Center Platto Hanno.

The facility will be closed April 1–10, 2026 for renovation. Starting in April, hours will change to 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. daily (weekdays and weekends/holidays).
